convert_sam2_checkpoint: convert a SAM2 checkpoint from Facebook's repository to HuggingFace Transformers format
run_convert_cli_sam2: run the SAM2 conversion CLI to convert a model checkpoint to HuggingFace format and save locally
push_convert_sam2_to_hub: convert a SAM2 checkpoint and push the resulting model and processor to the HuggingFace Hub
get_sam2_config: get the HuggingFace config for a SAM2 model variant based on its name string
replace_sam2_keys: replace and remap state dict keys from the original SAM2 checkpoint to HuggingFace naming convention
